newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLO yield curve steepens after 4-5 yr surge.
newsitem.headline: OLO yield curve steepens after 4-5 yr surge.

text.p: The Belgian linear bond yield curve steepened on Wednesday after a flurry of buying activity focused on the four- to five-year area, traders said.
"(A large player) has been turning his position," one Brussels trader said.
"The market is completely illiquid. The movement is one-sided with everybody going after the same bids," he said.
The yield on four-year OLOs 25 and 7 fell about 10 basis points to 4.53 and 4.57 percent. The five-year OLO 10 slid to 4.85 percent from 4.95.
